title.en: Ship a personal site with Next.js static export
title.id: Menerbitkan situs pribadi dengan static export Next.js
title.jv: Nerbitake situs pribadi nganggo static export Next.js

description.en: How this website is built and shipped: MDX content in three languages, static export without a server, and zero-cost hosting on Cloudflare Pages.
description.id: Bagaimana situs ini dibangun dan diterbitkan: konten MDX dalam tiga bahasa, static export tanpa server, dan hosting tanpa biaya di Cloudflare Pages.
description.jv: Kepriye situs iki digawakake lan diterbitake: konten MDX ing telung basa, static export tanpa server, lan hosting tanpa biaya ing Cloudflare Pages.

title.en: Static first: personal websites on Cloudflare Pages
title.id: Static first: situs pribadi di Cloudflare Pages
title.jv: Static first: situs pribadi ing Cloudflare Pages

description.en: A community session on static-first architecture: choosing rendering per route, i18n without a server, and deploying an exported Next.js site to the edge.
description.id: Sesi komunitas tentang arsitektur static-first: memilih rendering per route, i18n tanpa server, dan mem-deploy situs Next.js hasil export ke edge.
description.jv: Sesi komunitas babagan arsitektur static-first: milih rendering saben route, i18n tanpa server, lan ng-deploy situs Next.js asil export menyang edge.
